topic: Structure and organization of human cells, musculo-skeletal system, blood, cardiovascular system, and respiratory system
question: Define anatomical terms of position: anterior, posterior, lateral
answer: Anterior (ventral): Front of the body. Posterior (dorsal): Back of the body. Lateral: Away from the midline of the body.

subject: Human Anatomy I
topic: Structure and organization of human cells, musculo-skeletal system, blood, cardiovascular system, and respiratory system
question: What are the two types of cell division?
answer: Meiosis (reduction division producing gametes with half the chromosome number) and Mitosis (division producing two identical daughter cells with the same chromosome number as the parent cell).

subject: Human Anatomy I
topic: Structure and organization of human cells, musculo-skeletal system, blood, cardiovascular system, and respiratory system
question: What are the main body cavities?
answer: Dorsal cavity (cranial and spinal cavities) and Ventral cavity (thoracic and abdominopelvic cavities). The thoracic cavity contains the pleural and pericardial cavities; the abdominopelvic contains abdominal and pelvic cavities.

subject: Human Anatomy I
topic: Structure and organization of human cells, musculo-skeletal system, blood, cardiovascular system, and respiratory system
question: Name the major bones of the human body
answer: Skull (cranium, mandible), vertebrae (cervical, thoracic, lumbar, sacrum, coccyx), ribs, sternum, clavicle, scapula, humerus, radius, ulna, pelvis (ilium, ischium, pubis), femur, patella, tibia, fibula, tarsals, metatarsals, phalanges.

subject: Human Anatomy I
topic: Structure and organization of human cells, musculo-skeletal system, blood, cardiovascular system, and respiratory system
question: What are the types of muscles in the human body?
answer: Skeletal muscle (voluntary, striated), Smooth muscle (involuntary, non-striated), Cardiac muscle (involuntary, striated, found only in heart)

subject: Human Anatomy I
topic: Structure and organization of human cells, musculo-skeletal system, blood, cardiovascular system, and respiratory system
question: Describe the blood flow through the heart
answer: Deoxygenated blood enters right atrium from superior/inferior vena cava → through tricuspid valve to right ventricle → through pulmonary valve to pulmonary artery → lungs (oxygenation) → pulmonary veins to left atrium → through mitral/bicuspid valve to left ventricle → through aortic valve to aorta → body

question: What are the organs of the respiratory system?
answer: Nose, pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, alveoli, lungs
